title: The scalar minimizer has a genuine periodic vector potential
statement: For ANY homogeneous quartic F,L=ell:A with invertible ell,C=L^2m+lambda det(A)L,p=F+C+nuL^2,q=2Lm+lambda det(A),R=F-q^2/(4nu),fix ANY affine M and FIXED smooth mean-zero actual gradient G with L(G)=0. Among ALL smooth mean-zero actual gradient H,the epsilon^-4limit of <p(epsilon M+epsilon G+epsilon^2H)>-p(epsilon M) has minimum EXACTLY Delta_R(M,G),ATTAINED. Psi=q(M+G)-q(M)=2L(M)m(G)+lambda[cof(M):G+detG] has mean0 by actual determinant null identities. Fourth coefficient is Delta_F+<zPsi>+nu<z^2>,z=L(H);unique scalar minimizer z*=-Psi/(2nu). H*=ell^-T Hess Delta^-1z* is compatible and attains L(H*)=z*. Any additional L-free gradient has same coefficient. For rough L4 G,Psi is L2 and right inverse need not be L4;smooth approximation preserves infimum/strict transfer,not literal rough attainment. This is NOT infimum over epsilon-dependent unbounded H,unrestrictedGamma-limit,full QC,sharp threshold equality or fixed-F capacity attainment.

requires: Homogeneous real F quartic;invertible2x2coefficient matrixell of L;m linear,lambda real,nu>0 and specified C,q,R forms.

Fixed smooth actual mean-zero periodic G=Dphi satisfying L(G)=0 pointwise,all affine M;H ranges over smooth actual mean-zero gradients. Use determinant compatibility identities,not arbitrary matrix laws.
Literal attainment asserted only smooth fixed-field coefficient. Rough L4 approximation statement is weaker and does not grant L4 attaining corrector.
